title: William A. Clement and North Carolina Mutual Life Insurance Company business group, circa 1965-1970
creator: Unknown
description: Photograph of a large group of Black men and women, including William A. Clement, posing in formal attire outside of a North Carolina Mutual Life Insurance Company office building. Behind the group, a dark banner adorned with white trim displays the number "27," suggesting a district office or an anniversary celebration, with a stone church visible in the background. Based on the clothing, hairstyles, and automobile partially visible on the left, the image likely dates to the late 1960s.
